completion:
# Instructions on how to document structural defects

1. Refer to the periodic maintenance reports.
2. Identify the sections that have defects.
3. Clearly describe the location, extent and severity of each defect.
4. Include photos, if possible.
5. Estimate the required repairs and cost.
6. Document any necessary safety precautions.
7. Send the completed report to the appropriate authority.
